metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where I aimed at shadows and Valorant said ‘Sure, let’s confuse them’
metadata.description:
Wait, I swear I was shooting ghosts!
Enemy must be too busy dodging air.
Click if your aim’s as random as your brain.
Valorant logic: 100% certified nonsense.

Click if your kills also feel like glitches in the matrix!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
